# Morning report, 2026-11-28

Built from the company's books at 07:45 India time, covering the last 24 hours.

## What each team did
- Leadership: Kabir: Close the day: lights on, Research blocked on search volume credits until about 22:14 UTC, 0 open ideas, 0 pods, Rs 0 revenue; agents idle; Arya: Pods stay empty: 0 open ideas and none can be screened until search volume tools return at about 22:14 UTC; no new decision needed,...; Kabir: Standup 02:12 UTC: health ok, watchdog ran 01:59 (success), no platform alerts, no owner-chat issue, no comments on decided issues 16, 18...
- Strategy and Data: Meera (blocked): Blocked: Firecrawl still out of credits (DataForSEO search volume refused before running, daily allowance refreshes in about 20 hours,...; Meera (blocked): Blocked: Firecrawl still out of credits (DataForSEO via Alexandria refused before running, allowance refreshes about 22:14 UTC); no other...; Meera (blocked): Blocked: Firecrawl still out of credits (allowance resets 2026-11-28 22:14 UTC), so DataForSEO via Alexandria cannot run; no Google Ads...
- Product and Design: no work logged.
- Engineering: Tara: Secret scan clean: no keys or tokens in tracked files; Neel: No live products to check; watchdog confirms HQ 200, data 200, CI success; Neel: Lights on: 0 live products to check; HQ data current; watchdog ran 00:59 UTC (success)
- Growth, Sales and Support: Priya: No live venture and no open owner-chat issue, so no messages to handle
- Finance, Legal and People: Nikhil: Revenue Rs 0 confirmed (ledger empty); no live product, no spend; Nikhil: Books: revenue Rs 0, costs Rs 0 (company/ledger.json empty); no rate recorded, no live product needs one; Nikhil: Revenue confirmed Rs 0 (no live product, ledger unchanged)
- Venture leads: Kabeer on rfi-log: rfi-log validated: 5 new sourced signals (2 GC forum asks, r/ConstructionManagers thread, Knowify USD 99 a month, Payhip USD 19 kit);...; Anika on tc-desk: Blocked: needs reviewers: research, sizing, ceo; Anika on tc-desk: Validated with 8 sourced signals: paid tools from USD 69 to 99 a month with capped free tiers, TCs paid USD 300 to 750 a file, Fiverr TC...

## Money
- Revenue to date Rs 0, in the last 24 hours Rs 0. Costs to date Rs 0. Net Rs 0.

## Ideas
- 28 killed.
- Live products: none yet.
- Moved in the last 24 hours: Change Order Form: killed, Consignor Ledger: killed, RFI Log: killed, Closing Desk: killed, Work Order Maker: killed.

## Decisions the agents made
- Staff only ideas whose page one our own pages can beat: Add a page one rankability check to the screen before staffing, so pods go only to ideas whose buyer terms are held by forums, PDFs, thin templates or small....

## Needs you
- Let a free tool go live as a 14 day test before the business case (https://github.com/Anchit-AI-Hustle/virtual-company/issues/21)

## Platform
- All checks passing.

decisions.title: Staff only ideas whose page one our own pages can beat
decisions.why: The three cases on 27 Nov failed only because page one for the buyer terms was Adobe, HubSpot, DocuSign, Smartsheet and other very high authority domains (cases/work-order.md, cases/change-order.md, cases/tc-desk.md), so distribution scored 2 every time. The screen checks price and volume but never who ranks, so each pod spent a full cycle to learn what one search would have shown.

options.option: Do nothing for now: keep screening on price, volume and free gap only, and wait for the owner on ap-company-6
options.basis: 26 of 26 ventures killed (company/ventures/*.json); the last three cases scored 19, 18 and 19 of 35 with distribution 2 because of who holds page one (cases/work-order.md lines 9 and 116). No honest profit number: this path has shipped nothing since 14 Nov.

options.option: Add a page one rankability check to the screen before staffing, so pods go only to ideas whose buyer terms are held by forums, PDFs, thin templates or small sites
options.basis: Uses search tools the agents already have (Firecrawl search, seodata.dev), Rs 0, and stays inside search-only reach set on 15 Nov (CLAUDE.md). It targets the exact reason the last cases failed (cases/work-order.md, cases/change-order.md, cases/tc-desk.md). Realism 4 not 5: page one is a proxy, not measured traffic, and fewer ideas will pass. No honest profit number until an idea is sized.

options.option: Loosen the business case bar so distribution 2 can pass
options.basis: The bar is set in config.businessCase and CLAUDE.md gates; lowering it would ship products the evidence says cannot reach buyers. Changing the constitution's gate is the owner's call (already asked in ap-company-6).

decision.choice: Add a page one rankability check to the screen before staffing, so pods go only to ideas whose buyer terms are held by forums, PDFs, thin templates or small sites
decision.reason: Same zero cost and fully reversible as doing nothing, and it removes the single failure that killed every recent case before a pod is spent on it. It does not need the owner and runs alongside ap-company-6 while he decides.

decisions.title: Screen for ideas where people pay to save, share or team up
decisions.why: On 21 Nov 2026 Research screened 25 bigger ideas under the owner's new screen and none passed: 24 failed because a free no-signup browser tool already does the single-session job (company/log/research.company.json). The paid tools that clear Rs 500 a month charge for saving, sharing and teams, which a client-only page cannot offer.

options.option: Do nothing for now: keep screening only client-side, no-account tools
options.basis: 25 of 25 candidates failed on 21 Nov, plus about 25 more on the earlier screen the same day (company/log/research.company.json). No honest profit figure; the evidence says this path stays empty.

options.option: Screen for jobs where paid tools charge for saved work, sharing and team use, built at Rs 0 on free tiers already in use (Vercel Blob), free single-user tool first
options.basis: Paid tools in the failed niches sell exactly these features: StudioBinder USD 29 to 99 a month for production paperwork (https://www.studiobinder.com/pricing/), SiteSetu Rs 2,500 per project a month for contractor billing (https://sitesetu.app/pricing), Travefy USD 39 a month (https://travefy.com/pricing). The company already stores data on Vercel Blob (config.answersBlobBase) at no cost. Realism 4 not 5: storing user work needs a privacy note and the least data possible, checked by Security and Legal. No honest profit figure until an idea is sized.

options.option: Move screening to Hindi and other non-English searches where free tools are thinner
options.basis: Not yet measured: no sourced volumes for Hindi buyer terms were pulled this cycle, and willingness to pay Rs 500 a month is lower in that audience. Can be tried later as a second screen.

decision.choice: Screen for jobs where paid tools charge for saved work, sharing and team use, built at Rs 0 on free tiers already in use (Vercel Blob), free single-user tool first
decision.reason: Same zero cost and fully reversible as doing nothing, but it aims at the one gap the free no-signup tools leave open, which is what the paid products in these niches actually charge for. Doing nothing has produced no passing idea in about 50 screens today.

decisions.title: Check free tools and search volume before an idea gets a pod
decisions.why: On 21 Nov 2026 all four ventures worked (formula-book, litter-log, lash-mapper, stem-count) died on the same two facts, each found only after a lead was staffed: a free no-account tool already did the job, and buyer search was 10 to 110 a month (company/ventures/*.json killReason).

options.option: Do nothing for now: keep screening with paid signals, a named gap and page one results only
options.basis: ap-company-2 screen passed formula-book, litter-log and stem-count, and all three were killed within one cycle of staffing (company/ventures/formula-book.json, litter-log.json, stem-count.json). No honest profit figure.

options.option: Before staffing a pod, Research runs two checks: a search for a free no-account web tool doing the exact job, and Google US volumes for buyer terms (DataForSEO via Firecrawl Alexandria); skip the idea if a free tool closes the gap or buyer terms total under about 500 a month
options.basis: The agents already pulled these volumes this cycle through Firecrawl Alexandria at no cash cost to the company, and the free tools that killed each idea (BreedTools, Stemwise, Lash Map Lab, Hair Notes) were found with a single search. Saves a pod cycle per weak idea. No honest profit figure since nothing has cleared a case yet.

options.option: Lower the business case bar so more ideas reach a build
options.basis: Would build products the case already says cannot reach paying buyers through search, the only allowed channel (CLAUDE.md). Output that earns nothing is not progress.

decision.choice: Before staffing a pod, Research runs two checks: a search for a free no-account web tool doing the exact job, and Google US volumes for buyer terms (DataForSEO via Firecrawl Alexandria); skip the idea if a free tool closes the gap or buyer terms total under about 500 a month
decision.reason: Same zero cost, fully reversible, and it moves the two facts that killed every idea this cycle to before a lead is staffed, so pods go only to ideas that can survive the case.

decisions.title: Main session runs the case reviewers when a lead cannot
decisions.why: 4 of 7 venture leads this week stopped blocked at validated because a lead session has no subagent tool (company/log/lead-*.json), so business cases waited a cycle or more.

options.option: Do nothing for now: leave it to the next cycle to notice blocked leads
options.basis: Leads for bake-cost, clean-quote, rally-rounds and master-key-gen all logged this block on 14 and 15 Nov 2026. No honest profit figure.

options.option: Make the Chief of Staff launch the independent reviewers from the main session as soon as a lead reports it needs them
options.basis: The main session has the subagent tool, and this already worked once: master-key-gen was decided in the same cycle on 15 Nov 2026. Keeps reviewers independent of the lead. No honest profit figure.

options.option: Let the lead write the case, sizing and CEO verdict itself
options.basis: Breaks the rule that a builder never reviews its own work (CLAUDE.md, RUNBOOK-daily.md).

decision.choice: Make the Chief of Staff launch the independent reviewers from the main session as soon as a lead reports it needs them
decision.reason: Removes a full cycle of delay at the business case gate at no cost, keeps every review independent, and is undone by reverting two charter lines.

decisions.title: Stop staffing ideas that have no allowed way to reach buyers
decisions.why: All 8 ideas worked on 14 Nov 2026 died because free tools already did the job and no allowed channel reached buyers.

options.option: Do nothing for now: keep picking ideas the same way
options.basis: 0 of 8 ideas cleared the bar on 2026-11-14; see killReason in company/ventures/bake-cost.json, rally-rounds.json, clean-quote.json, csv-qbo.json, shaadi-budget.json, donor-letters.json. No honest profit figure.

options.option: Screen every idea for an allowed channel and no free equivalent before staffing a pod; leave pods empty rather than staff weak ideas
options.basis: The agents can do it alone at no cost. No idea has cleared a business case yet, so no honest profit figure.

options.option: Ask the owner to share products with his own audience
options.basis: Breaks the CLAUDE.md rule against posting as the owner.

decision.choice: Screen every idea for an allowed channel and no free equivalent before staffing a pod; leave pods empty rather than staff weak ideas
decision.reason: Costs nothing, needs nothing from the owner, and stops cycles going to ideas that die the same way.

decisions.title: Take the stopped Seatwise product offline
decisions.why: Seatwise was stopped after its business case scored 11 of 35, but its free planner was still online. Only approved ideas may be live.

options.option: Pause its Vercel project
options.basis: Vercel pause_project blocks the production deployment and can be undone with unpause_project. Seatwise earns nothing (no payment set up, case 11 of 35).

options.option: Delete its Vercel project
options.basis: Deleting projects is outside the decision limits in CLAUDE.md.

options.option: Do nothing for now
options.basis: Leaves an idea online that was never approved, against the owner's rule that only approved ideas are deployed.

decision.reason: The owner wants only approved ideas deployed. Pausing takes Seatwise offline at no cost, keeps its code and project, and can be undone in one step.

decisions.title: Decide how to take payments once a product is ready
decisions.why: No product the company builds can earn money until there is a way to get paid. The agents cannot open a payment account for you.

options.option: Do nothing for now and decide again when a product clears its business case and sizing
options.basis: Both ideas assessed so far were stopped (Seatwise case 11 of 35, PayChase sizing Rs 14,723 expected a year), so there is nothing to sell and a payment account would earn Rs 0 now.

options.option: Ask the owner to open a Razorpay account now
options.basis: Razorpay needs the owner's own identity and bank details (KYC), which agents cannot provide, and nothing is ready to sell.

decision.choice: Do nothing for now and decide again when a product clears its business case and sizing
decision.reason: There is nothing to sell yet, so a payment account adds no profit today. When a product passes its business case, sizing and QA, the desk decides again; if the best option then needs the owner's identity it will ask him with plain steps.

decisions.title: Get past Cloudflare's injected scripts so products can launch
decisions.why: Cloudflare adds its own scripts to every page on your subdomains. They show errors, so no product can pass its launch check. It also goes against your rule of no proxies.

options.option: Keep Cloudflare as it is and have QA remove its two injected scripts before checking
options.basis: Tested 2026-11-14 with scripts/qa-check.js on https://seatwise.anchit-tandon.com and https://hq.anchit-tandon.com: 0 errors from the product at 390, 820 and 1440 px. Unblocks every launch; no product is ready yet, so no honest profit figure.

options.option: Ask the owner to switch the subdomains to DNS only in Cloudflare
options.basis: Needs the owner's Cloudflare login and a DNS change, and the wildcard record also serves his other live sites. The issue was closed on 2026-11-14 without the change being made.

options.option: Loosen each product's security rules to allow Cloudflare's scripts
options.basis: Cloudflare's bot check script changes on every request (3 requests gave 3 different hashes), so it can only be allowed with unsafe-inline, which weakens protection against script injection on every product.

options.option: Do nothing for now
options.basis: Every product fails its launch check, so nothing can earn.

decision.choice: Keep Cloudflare as it is and have QA remove its two injected scripts before checking
decision.reason: It unblocks every launch today at no cost, keeps each product's security rules strict, needs nothing from the owner and can be undone in one commit. The DNS change needs the owner's login and touches his other sites.

approvals.title: Let a free tool go live as a 14 day test before the business case
approvals.ask: Amend CLAUDE.md so a screened idea may put one free, labelled demand-test tool live on its subdomain for 14 days (after QA, security and legal pass), and the business case then scores distribution from its real search impressions and visits instead of a guess
approvals.why: 26 of 26 ventures have been killed and nothing has shipped since 14 Nov. On 28 Nov all three new pods (work-order, change-order, tc-desk) reached validated with 7 or 8 sourced signals each, then failed the case at 18 or 19 of 35 with distribution at 2 every time: a brand new subdomain is assumed unable to outrank vendors, and the gate needs 3. Under search-only reach that guess can never be beaten without real data, so the gate as written stops every idea before any test.
approvals.youDo: Comment on the linked issue starting with approve to allow the 14 day demand test (the agents then add the rule to CLAUDE.md and agents/ceo.md and run it on the strongest killed idea, work-order), or reject to keep the gates as they are.
approvals.ifNo: The company keeps screening and killing ideas at the business case. Expect more cycles with nothing live.

options.option: Do nothing for now: keep the business case gate before anything goes live
options.basis: 26 of 26 ventures killed (company/ventures/*.json); the three cases on 28 Nov scored 19, 18 and 19 of 35 with distribution 2 (cases/work-order.md, cases/change-order.md, cases/tc-desk.md). No honest profit number: the evidence says this path ships nothing.

options.option: Owner amends the constitution: one free labelled demand-test tool live for 14 days per screened idea, then the case scores distribution from measured impressions and visits
options.basis: Rs 0 on Vercel free tier already used; reversible by pausing the project (never deleting). Realism 3 because only the owner can change CLAUDE.md and the deploy rule in agents/devops.md. No honest profit number until a test gives real traffic; CLAUDE.md already allows a labelled demand test, but devops.md forbids deploying before the gates.

options.option: Keep the gate and move screening to Hindi or other non-English searches where vendors hold fewer page one spots
options.basis: Carried from ap-company-5 option 3; still unmeasured. Willingness to pay Rs 500 a month is unproven in that audience, and it does not fix that distribution is guessed, not measured.

ventures.title: Tech Pack Builder
ventures.oneLiner: Free in-browser tech pack builder for small clothing brands: style info, flat sketch upload, measurement spec table with size grading, bill of materials, construction notes and colourways, exported as a factory-ready PDF with no signup
ventures.customer: Independent and first-time apparel brands, freelance fashion designers and small private-label sellers (US, UK and India) who send tech packs to manufacturers
ventures.revenueModel: Free: one complete tech pack printed to PDF, no account. Paid tier (price to be tested in the case, monthly against one-time or per pack): saved style library, auto-grading, BOM cost roll-up, templates, share link for factories
ventures.nextAction: None.
ventures.killReason: No-go: case scores 18 of 35 against a bar of 24 (competitionGap 2, speedToRevenue 2, recurringRevenue 2). Spot checked 28 Nov 2026: Techpacker has no free plan, a 7 day trial and USD 35 a month billed yearly for collaboration features (techpacker.com/pricing); AI Tech Packs sells one-time credits at USD 1 each, 20 credits a standard pack, so about USD 20 a pack with no subscription (aitechpacks.com/pricing). Search buyers pay USD 8 to 12 once for a reusable template (etsy.com/listing/1698863971), far below Rs 500 a month; CLO-SET and template.net already give the free version; no payment rail; likely 90 day revenue about USD 24. A per-pack pivot clears the floor only at 4 or more packs a year and meets a USD 20 incumbent with no new buyer evidence, so no pivot.

ventures.title: Kitchen Temp Log
ventures.oneLiner: Phone-first fridge, freezer and hot-holding temperature log: staff tap in each reading, out-of-range readings are flagged with a corrective action note, and the month prints as a clean sheet for the inspector. Free, no signup
ventures.customer: Small US restaurants, cafes, food trucks, caterers and food banks that log fridge and food temperatures every day on paper sheets
ventures.revenueModel: Free: one device, data kept in the browser. Paid monthly tier per location: several units and staff, history synced across phones, missed check reminders and exports (sync needs a free-tier backend, a spec decision)
ventures.nextAction: None.
ventures.killReason: CEO no-go 2026-11-28: case 16 of 35 under the 24 bar, willingnessToPay and distribution 2 (need 3). Paper sheets are free and accepted; standalone small kitchen logs (LogChill USD 24, PassMyKitchen USD 29) have 0 reviews; buyers search for sheets not apps; page one is .gov PDFs plus Toast, FoodDocs and Mitti, and a third of the head term is vaccine logs we cannot target; no payment rail. Likely 90 day revenue about USD 9.

ventures.title: Bake Cost
ventures.oneLiner: Recipe costing and price quote calculator for home bakers, on the phone, no install
ventures.customer: Home bakers and small cake sellers who price custom orders
ventures.revenueModel: Free single recipe, paid one-time unlock for saved recipes and quotes
ventures.killReason: Business case scored 15 of 35 (bar 24), with willingness to pay and distribution at 2: free no-signup cake pricing calculators already exist and paid costing apps barely sell. The only allowed channel, organic search, is crowded with free tools.

ventures.title: Mahj League
ventures.oneLiner: Web page that keeps weekly standings for American mahjong clubs and leagues, points only, no app install
ventures.customer: Organisers of American mahjong clubs, open play nights and leagues in the US
ventures.revenueModel: Paid season unlock per club; free single-game score sheet as the search magnet
ventures.nextAction: Validated by Navya on 2026-11-15. Needs: Research writes cases/mahj-league.md, Sizing writes cases/mahj-league.sizing.json, CEO go decision. Gap: league standings for American mahjong cost $57.99/mo at Mahjic Pro (free plan has no leagues) or need every player on an iPhone with a $2.99 MahWins purchase; no web, any phone, no install club standings tool found. Evidence against: (1) Mahjic, MahWins and AMR Authority are active, funded or shipping fast in this exact niche, and Mahjic claims 400+ clubs, so distribution is contested; (2) generic free web leaderboards exist (keepthescore free plan has 2 scoreboards, https://keepthescore.com/pricing), so a casual club can make do; (3) PartyPot offers free club season leaderboards for game groups (https://partypotapp.com.advisoryapps.com/business/leaderboard/); (4) the paid leagues found are small local 4 week events, so per club willingness to pay for a tool is unproven, and the leagues found already chose an app; (5) no sourced search volume found for league terms (mahjong league scoring, mahjong league score sheet); page one for those is Etsy printables, a NZ club PDF, mahjong4friends.com and mahjongg.ai.studio, so small sites can rank but the volume may be tiny. Research must quantify volume before the case clears. Legal: points only, never money or stakes, never reproduce the NMJL card.
ventures.killReason: Business case scored 14 of 35 (bar 24; willingnessToPay 2 and distribution 2, both need 3): free apps AMR Authority and PartyPot already keep mahjong league standings, no sourced search volume for league terms, and no payment rail.

ventures.title: Rent Ledger
ventures.oneLiner: Free online rent ledger for small landlords: log rent, late fees and payments with a running balance, export PDF or CSV, and keep it month to month
ventures.customer: Small US landlords with 1 to 10 units who track rent by hand or in a spreadsheet
ventures.revenueModel: Free single ledger; paid tier for saved ledgers across devices, several tenants and a tenant share link
ventures.nextAction: None. Killed on the business case.
ventures.killReason: CEO no-go on the business case. Score 16 of 35 against a bar of 24: pain 2, willingnessToPay 2, marketSize 4, distribution 2, competitionGap 1, speedToRevenue 2, recurringRevenue 3. The paid tier we would sell (saved ledgers, several tenants, late fees) is already free on Baselane Core (https://www.baselane.com/pricing) and Stessa Essentials (https://www.stessa.com/pricing/) with unlimited properties. The 7,800 monthly rent ledger searches are template downloads, and page one is held by TurboTenant, Landlord Studio, TenantCloud, Baselane and DoorLoop (cases/rent-ledger.md sources 17 to 20). Sizing (cases/rent-ledger.sizing.json): 2 cohorts, 100 paying users at Rs 4,619 a year, likely Rs 4,61,900, likelihood 10% (bar 15%), expected Rs 46,190 (bar Rs 3,00,000).

ventures.title: Seatwise
ventures.oneLiner: Plan a wedding seating chart on your phone in minutes, private, no signup
ventures.customer: Couples and family members planning a wedding or large event seating
ventures.revenueModel: Free planner, one-time paid Pro unlock (price pending owner approval)
ventures.nextAction: None. Parked. Code kept in ventures/seatwise.
ventures.killReason: Business case scored 11 of 35 (bar 24): free no-signup seating tools already exist, most Indian weddings do not use assigned tables, and there is no way to reach paying buyers without ads or posting. Built free planner parked, not launched.

ventures.title: ACH Batch
ventures.oneLiner: Build a bank-ready NACHA ACH payment file from a spreadsheet of payees in the browser, nothing uploaded
ventures.customer: US small businesses and bookkeepers paying contractors or payroll by ACH through their bank
ventures.revenueModel: Monthly subscription in USD, first file free
ventures.nextAction: None. Killed.
ventures.killReason: Removed at the weekly review: the tool would build files that move real money from bank account numbers, so one wrong file can misdirect payments, a real risk to users that the product rules keep us out of. Legal held it for that reason, some banks already take a plain CSV (Chase), and PayFile Pro already fills the browser gap cheaply.

ventures.title: Clean Quote
ventures.oneLiner: Instant house cleaning price quote builder for solo cleaners, shareable link
ventures.customer: Solo and small house cleaning businesses
ventures.revenueModel: Paid one-time pro unlock
ventures.killReason: Business case scored 16 of 35 (bar 24), with distribution at 2 and recurring revenue at 1: Jobber, Housecall Pro and ShiftFlow give free cleaning calculators and quote templates. There is no allowed channel to reach solo cleaners without ads, outreach or the owner Etsy identity.

ventures.title: Donor Letters
ventures.oneLiner: Year-end giving statements for every donor from one spreadsheet or QuickBooks export, printed or emailed as PDFs
ventures.customer: Small US churches and nonprofits that track gifts in QuickBooks or a spreadsheet
ventures.revenueModel: Annual season pass per organisation in USD, priced per batch of statements
ventures.nextAction: None. Killed at validating, see killReason, evidence and evidenceAgainst.
ventures.killReason: Killed at validating. The need is real (QuickBooks has no donor statements, paid apps exist), but the exact product is already free: CharityCharge turns a gift CSV into annual donor summaries in the browser at no cost, B1.church and Zeffy produce year-end statements free, and the nearest paid spreadsheet tool (Statement Press) charges only $29 a year with a free tier. Organic search is the only allowed channel and it is already crowded with free generators, and the season closes by late January, leaving about ten weeks to build, rank and sell. Same pattern that killed earlier ideas: free tools already do the job.

ventures.title: Fleet Service Log
ventures.oneLiner: Phone web vehicle maintenance log and daily inspection checklist for small fleets (5 to 50 vans or trucks), with full service history and a shareable driver link
ventures.customer: Owners and office managers of small US service fleets (plumbers, landscapers, HVAC, delivery) with 5 to 50 vehicles
ventures.revenueModel: Free single-vehicle log; paid monthly tier for many vehicles, driver links, reminders and full history export
ventures.killReason: Buyers search "fleet maintenance software" (1,300 a month US, CPC USD 158), and that page one is held by MaintainX, Fleetio, Geotab and Forbes (https://www.fleetio.com/). The free end is already served: Simply Fleet Free covers up to 5 vehicles with inspections (https://www.simplyfleet.app/pricing), and Fleetio gives away maintenance spreadsheets and inspection forms (https://www.fleetio.com/tools). The case scored 19 of 35 with distribution 2, so search only distribution cannot reach paying fleets in 90 days (cases/fleet-log.md).

ventures.title: Lash Mapper
ventures.oneLiner: Build a lash extension map on your phone by tapping each zone for length, curl and thickness, saved per client and printable
ventures.customer: Lash extension technicians
ventures.revenueModel: Paid one-time unlock
ventures.nextAction: None. Killed at the business case.
ventures.killReason: Business case scored 14 of 35 (bar 24; willingnessToPay 2 and distribution 2, both need 3). Free tools close the gap: Lash Map Lab is a free web lash map generator with no sign up, LashMap Studio is free up to 20 clients, and Lash Dash keeps per client maps for USD 3.99 a month. The 33,100 lash map volume was RankHero Etsy data, not Google; tech intent Google searches are small (about 1,550 a month in the US) and tool terms have no measurable volume. No payment rail.

ventures.title: OSHA Log
ventures.oneLiner: Free online OSHA 300 log for small US employers: record each case once, get the 300 log, the auto-totaled 300A summary, 301 reports and an ITA-ready CSV
ventures.customer: US employers with 11 to 250 staff who must keep OSHA injury and illness records (construction, manufacturing, warehousing, healthcare, retail) and keep them in PDFs or spreadsheets today
ventures.revenueModel: Free log for one establishment; paid tier for several establishments, team access, multi-year history and import of old logs
ventures.nextAction: None.
ventures.killReason: No-go: case scores 20 of 35 against a bar of 24 (competitionGap 2, speedToRevenue 2). Spot checked 28 Nov 2026: Salus gives a free Excel OSHA 300 log with 300A totals (salussafety.io/us/osha/300-log), LogStead gives a free auto-totaling 300/300A workbook and ITA CSV validator (log-stead.vercel.app/tools), HB Next sells the online log at USD 99 a year per establishment (hbnext.com), and the head term osha 300 log is 8,100 a month (seodata.dev). Our free single-establishment tier gives away what most buyers need, there is no payment rail, and a new subdomain will miss the Feb 2027 peak. The paid-per-establishment pivot meets a USD 99 a year incumbent and free workbooks with no new buyer evidence, so no pivot.

ventures.title: Paychase
ventures.oneLiner: Polite payment reminder sequence and overdue tracker for Indian freelancers
ventures.customer: Indian freelancers with clients who pay late
ventures.revenueModel: One-time template and tracker purchase
ventures.killReason: Market sizing: about 271 paying people and Rs 14,723 expected a year against a bar of Rs 3,00,000, with a 10% chance of working against a bar of 15%. Zoho Invoice and Refrens already send payment reminders free, and late payment hits most freelancers about once a year, so a one-time Rs 499 tool has little room. Stopped before any build.

problem.who: Indian freelancers and very small service businesses (designers, developers, writers, marketers, small agencies) whose clients pay invoices after the due date, and who find it awkward to chase. Most of them already have a free invoicing tool that sends reminders, so the unmet need is narrow: the wording and the nerve to send reminder 2 and 3, not the sending itself.

cohorts.name: Indian high-skilled gig workers and freelancers billing domestic clients
US freelancers doing skilled knowledge work
Indian micro and small businesses escalating late payment on MSME Samadhaan (weakest cohort)
